hero.heading: The Caldwell Beach House
hero.subheading: Oceanfront mornings. Mountain views. Room to gather.

overview: Make yourself at home on the water in Kaʻaʻawa. This two-story retreat brings the ocean into view from its living spaces and upper deck, with Mokoliʻi offshore and the Koʻolau mountains nearby.
Gather around the kitchen island, open the doors to the shoreline, or head upstairs for time on the deck. Four bedrooms accommodate up to eleven guests.
thingsToKnow: Check availability, current rates, house rules, and cancellation terms on Vacation Rental Oahu before reserving.
This is a two-story home. Three bedrooms are upstairs.
